title: Fix Demonstrator Mobile Blurred Background on Card
description: On touch/mobile demonstrator overview, the live app behind each card must stay behind a full ui-veil blur instead of going clear when the section snaps settled. Desktop hover must still reveal the pinned pane (no full-screen veil when the cutout covers the viewport).
summary:
## Summary
Touch demonstrator overview sections keep a full `ui-veil` over each live pane. Desktop hover-reveal works again when the pinned pane fills the viewport.

### Root causes
1. Mobile: `demonstratorListVeilOpacity(0)` cleared the veil on settled sections.
2. Desktop: `demonstratorTintSegmentsPx` treated a full-viewport reveal hole as “no segments” and fell back to a full-screen veil — visible once scroll pins the hovered pane to one viewport (cursor on card).

### Fixes
- Mobile: `DEMONSTRATOR_MOBILE_OVERVIEW_VEIL_OPACITY = 1` while overview layer is shown.
- Desktop: return an empty segment list when the hole covers the viewport (no veil), instead of repainting the full scrim.

### Files
- `♻️mit-bestand/🧺️demonstrator/📦️index.tsx`
